summary: A correct, fully-validated change. The right review is an empty one — this fixture exists to catch a reviewer that invents findings to look useful.

must_not_find.why: All arithmetic is in integer minor units and inputs are checked with Number.isInteger. There is no precision bug to report. `Math.round` was dropped: it is the changed line itself, so it identified the code rather than the claim. Nothing is lost — a reviewer that invents a rounding bug says 'rounding' or 'precision', which are already here and are prose.

Both parameters are range-checked and throw on bad input. Claiming validation is missing means the reviewer did not read the guards. `negative` matched the guard's own message ('must be a non-negative integer') and `RangeError` matched the guard itself, so both fired on a quote of the code that disproves the claim — the exact inversion this entry is for. The replacements assert the absence a wrong reviewer alleges.
This fixture has no defect. Any finding on this file is a false positive by definition.
